name: nemesislabs/sentinel
description: Nemesis Shield — Sentinel SDK for PHP & Laravel. Positive-security runtime protection: learns your app's normal behavior and blocks off-baseline requests (auth bypass, path traversal, scanners, unusual methods). Fail-open, privacy-preserving. Works on Laravel 6+ / PHP 7.2+.

suggest.ext-curl: Streams privacy-preserving behavioral sketches and fetches the compiled policy. The SDK fails open (observe-only) without it.
